verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but its client solutions include AI tooling. It describes a Generative AI legal assistant built with Legora, an 'Evaluate' tool that automates review and analysis of bidder responses, and AI-assisted document review via Luminance. None of this evidence shows users getting AI-generated insights or suggestions from their own data inside a self-serve product, and the AI parts rely on third-party partners alongside hands-on lawyer review. Missing for 10: confirmation the generative assistant is client-facing, documented in-product insight or suggestion features over user data, details of how outputs are delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A collaboration with Legora to develop our Generative AI legal assistant to streamline and enhance legal workflows.
By automating the review and analysis of bidder responses, our outsourcing tool "Evaluate" does the heavy lifting for you.
Using Luminance to combine the computing power of artificial intelligence with a hands-on review of documents
